methods.name: 💎 Đề Tinh Hoa (Dynamic Pruning)
methods.hypothesis: Dynamic pruning with Bayesian Model Averaging and Shannon entropy filtering removes uninformative tail numbers to achieve higher empirical hit rate than 30% baseline.

methods.name: 👑 Đề Thích Ứng Alpha
methods.hypothesis: Dynamic phase-shifting between attack and defensive pairs based on empirical transition hazard avoids prolonged drawdown runs.

methods.name: 🎯 Đề Gộp Tiêu Chuẩn
methods.hypothesis: Merging two diverse single-model sets at sweet-spot overlap produces a consolidated 43-number ticket with 2x weighting on consensus numbers.

methods.name: 🛡️ Đề Tam Trụ
methods.hypothesis: 3-tier consensus weighting (X3/X2/X1) across 3 orthogonal models provides maximum resilience during non-stationary regime shifts.

methods.name: 🔮 Đề Markov Bậc 2 & Gap Hazard
methods.hypothesis: Order-2 Markov state transitions combined with survival hazard decay model the rebound points of cold digits after 2-3 consecutive losses.

methods.name: 🕸️ Cầu Đồ Thị Vị Trí
methods.hypothesis: Graph correlation across positional nodes in previous day draw generates structural flow indicators for prize numbers.

methods.name: ⚛️ Lô Quantum Bayes 7D (QMBF)
methods.hypothesis: 7-dimensional Bayesian posterior estimation with Fourier rhythm harmonics models recurring clusters in 27 lottery prize slots.

methods.name: 🤖 Lô Quad-Hybrid v7.1
methods.hypothesis: Hybrid fusion of frequency, bridge flow, and anti-saturation filters eliminates cold traps and preserves positive expectation streaks.
